jobs.company: Alpha Petroleum Transport, Inc. II dba Alpha Environmental Engineering & Construction
jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description
Alpha Petroleum Transport, Inc. II dba Alpha Environmental Engineering & Construction is an environmental services company headquartered at 10060 Dawson Canyon Road in Corona, California. The organization provides specialized solutions that support regulatory compliance and environmentally responsible operations for its clients. Team members work on projects that address complex environmental challenges, with a focus on safety, reliability, and quality service. The company values technical expertise, field readiness, and collaboration across engineering, construction, and environmental disciplines. Joining Alpha offers the opportunity to contribute to protecting natural resources while supporting industrial and commercial clients.
Role Description
The Environmental Compliance Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Corona, CA. This position is responsible for knowing and understanding Proper Shipping Names, preparation of computer generated Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifests/Non-Hazardous Waste Manifests/Hazardous Materials Bill of Ladings/Universal Waste Manifests/Medical Waste Tracking Forms/Labels etc. Even though this Specialist will perform most of their work in the office, they may be asked to assist the Team with on-site waste services from time to time. Specialist should be willing and able to keep up with federal, state, and local environmental regulations across company operations and client projects. The role also involves providing environmental consulting support to project teams, coordinating corrective actions, maintaining accurate records, and participating in training and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen environmental performance.
Qualifications

Demonstrated skills in Environmental Compliance and Environmental Policy, with the ability to interpret and apply federal, state, and local regulations.
Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in reporting.
Effective communication skills to collaborate with drivers, field staff, management, regulators, and clients.
Ability to work safely in field and industrial environments, including valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally to project sites.
Preferred: Familiarity with California-specific environmental regulations.
